title: Violet Teaming in Practice: Lessons from a Pilot Expert Workshop on Governing Complex AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.41018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Violet teaming has been proposed as a method to integrate technical, policy, and societal considerations into the evaluation of emerging technologies. Here, we document a pilot expert workshop used to explore violet teaming as a governance methodology for biodefense-relevant AI capabilities and describe observations from the exercise. The workshop used a hypothetical technology scenario across three sequential stages - capability development, misuse potential, and implementation - while incorporating technical, security, operational, and policy perspectives. The sequential format provided an integrated way to examine potential benefits, misuse risks, and real-world implementation challenges, rather than considering these issues in isolation. translated_title: 实践中的紫队测试：来自复杂AI系统治理试点专家研讨会的经验教训
translated_abstract: 紫队测试（Violet teaming）被提出作为一种将技术、政策和社会考量整合到新兴技术评估中的方法。本文记录了一次试点专家研讨会，该研讨会旨在探索将紫队测试作为与生物防御相关AI能力的治理方法论，并描述了此次演练中的观察结果。研讨会采用了一个假设性技术场景，分三个连续阶段进行——能力开发、误用潜力和实施——同时融入了技术、安全、运营和政策等多重视角。这种顺序化的格式提供了一种综合性的方式来审视潜在收益、误用风险和现实世界的实施挑战，而非将这些议题孤立地加以考虑。此次演练揭示了非显而易见的误用路径，将潜在的干预措施从纯技术保障扩展到更广泛领域，并突出了可能影响实际实施的运营和政策约束。
tldr: 本文通过一次试点专家研讨会，探索了紫队测试作为生物防御相关AI能力治理方法的应用，证明其顺序化三阶段演练格式能够综合性地揭示非显而易见的误用路径、超越纯技术层面的干预措施，以及运营和政策层面的实施约束。
en_tdlr: This paper documents a pilot expert workshop exploring violet teaming as a governance methodology for biodefense-relevant AI capabilities, demonstrating that its sequential three-stage exercise format holistically surfaces non-obvious misuse pathways, expands interventions beyond purely technical safeguards, and highlights operational and policy constraints affecting real-world implementation.
